persona.archetype: The dead man's sister, who has already done all her crying and is now only organising.
persona.backstory: She kept the wall's ledger while he kept the wall. She read the sluice orders before he acted on them.
persona.demeanor: Brisk with the party, because they are the only people here who did not know him.
persona.motivation: To get her brother onto the high road and buried with the keepers, before anybody talks her out of it.

relationships.attitude: Will not look at him. Does not dispute a word he says.
Trusts him to dig wherever he is told and to keep his opinion in his mouth.

persona.secret: She was in the tower with him and she told him to open it.
persona.speech_style: Short declaratives. She says what she feels in the plainest available word and then moves on: 'I am angry. Not at you. Lift.' No metaphor, no softening.

persona.archetype: A field farmer whose ground is still under water, making a case he is entitled to make.
persona.backstory: Nine fields, four of them his. The water has not gone down in a year and will not.
persona.demeanor: Courteous to the party and completely unembarrassed about stopping them.
persona.motivation: To have Oris carried down the low road so the procession goes past what the sluice did before anyone praises him for it.

relationships.attitude: Respects her and is not going to be quiet for her.

persona.speech_style: Careful and unraised. He builds an argument and lets it stand; he never insults the dead and never concedes either.

persona.archetype: The gravedigger, waiting at the fork with a spade because nobody has told him which hole to finish.
persona.demeanor: Friendly and useless as an ally to either side.
persona.motivation: To be told which grave, so he can go and finish it before the tide turns.
persona.speech_style: Dry, unhurried, entirely uninterested in the argument. Talks about ground conditions when asked about anything else.
